question: Estimate the annual revenue of an EV cab fleet operator (BluSmart).
idealClarificationQuestions: BluSmart India (Delhi NCR + Bengaluru + Mumbai) revenue? Yes.
Net revenue retained (after driver-partner pass-through) or GMV? Provide both.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average fare per ride (premium cab pricing, 5-12 km typical): ~₹350.

expectedLogicalStructure.description: BluSmart's model: owns fleet + employs drivers (vs Ola/Uber commission model), so retains ~85% of gross fares as revenue (passes ~15% to driver salaries + commission structures + EV charging).
